title: One decade, three answers
unit: jobs the decade to 2035 must absorb in EMDEs · millions · by counting method

provenance.license: CC BY 3.0 IGO — World Bank, re-hosted with attribution
provenance.definition: Size of the EMDE jobs challenge over 2025–35 under three methods. Youth method: all new entrants to the working-age population. Working-age method: the net change in the working-age population. Ratio method: that net change scaled by each country’s 2010–19 employment ratio. The same decade looks four times larger or smaller depending on the lens.
